name: Graph relation readback boundary
decision: KRN graph-brain work may expose existing SourceClaimEdge relation counts, relation support, graph-aware caveats, and query-shape diagnostics through read-only source and brain search, but relation readback must not be treated as proof of entity extraction, graph ranking quality, source truth, or GraphRAG-quality reasoning.
falsifier: A future graph-brain slice treats SourceClaimEdge relation counts, graphReadback, or relationSupport as proof of entity extraction, source truth, graph retrieval quality, or product-ready GraphRAG behavior.
doesNotProve: This card does not prove graph ranking quality, entity extraction, relation correctness, source truth, GraphRAG-quality reasoning, or KRN product readiness.
